name: Selecting a different storage variant of Pixel 7 Pro navigates to that storage's PDP

preconditions.note: Pixel 7 Pro has 128GB (non_pta) and 256GB (pta_approved) variants — exposed via the .ov-grid section on PDP

steps.script: (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ov-grid .ov-card:not(.current)')); const storages = cards.map(c => Array.from(c.querySelectorAll('.ov-chip')).find(ch => /GB/.test(ch.textContent || ''))?.textContent?.trim() || ''); const has256 = storages.some(s => s.includes('256')); return { otherCount: cards.length, storages, has256 }; })()
steps.description: Other variants section contains a 256 GB card

steps.script: (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ov-grid .ov-card:not(.current)')); for (const c of cards) { const chips = Array.from(c.querySelectorAll('.ov-chip')); if (chips.some(ch => /256/.test(ch.textContent || ''))) { c.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); c.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

businessContext: Storage tiers of the same model must be discoverable so customers can compare price/capacity. Pixel 7 Pro has 128GB and 256GB.
